reasoning: 19.3.1（FB2.1）規定顯示排序為：全部資料夾依字母序在前、全部播放清單依字母序次之、全部歌曲依字母序最後。037 拆成三個 leaf，分別對應三個型別的排序與相對位置。082-01 只驗資料夾之間的字母序；082-02／03 各自同時驗「型別的相對位置」與「該型別內的字母序」，因為 spec 對這兩件事是併述的（all playlists in alphabetical order second）。前置條件要求每個型別各有兩個以上且命名的字母序可辨，否則排序無法判定。註（A-033）：本條是顯示排序，與 FB1.1／FF4 的播放順序不同——page 32 的範例顯示同一個 root 的顯示為 Pop、Rock、Dancing、Get Low，播放卻是 Dancing、Get Low 在先。§8.5：catalog 建立狀態由 BT1.9／COM-070~073 擁有，不寫進 Pre-Condition（沿用 COM-057 的取捨）。優先級：排序錯亂會讓使用者難以定位，三筆皆 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 082-01 驗資料夾字母序，082-02 驗播放清單位置與字母序，082-03 驗歌曲位置與字母序

tcs.test_item:
The system shall sort folders in alphabetical order in Folder browse.

(Folders sorted alphabetically)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive whose root holds at least three folders with alphabetically distinguishable names, at least two playlists and at least two songs is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Read the folder line items displayed in the Browse List and their order
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The folders are displayed in alphabetical order by name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display playlists after folders and sort playlists alphabetically.

(Playlists positioned after folders and sorted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive whose root holds at least three folders with alphabetically distinguishable names, at least two playlists and at least two songs is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Read the line items displayed in the Browse List and their order
5. Read the order of the playlist line items among themselves
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. Every playlist line item is displayed below the last folder line item
5. The playlists are displayed in alphabetical order by name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
